## `neuro.uint16Array.find`

Instance method on `Uint16Array.prototype`.

> Returns the value of the first element in the array where predicate is true, and undefined
> otherwise.

## Signatures

```ts
find(input: { uint16Array: <receiver>; predicate?: (value: number; index: number; obj: Uint16Array) => boolean; thisArg?: any; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Uint16Array.prototype.find` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
